test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A is the paternal grandfather of B, D is the brother of A and E is the son of D. How is E related to B?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9a2156646b4721b70cdcfc8631af4954e0403a9d8607fb036c8e196d55d5311.png] 

1) A is the paternal grandfather of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e277952d3fa9c78d797f9fa31c8e804cb7ce64c8dbc39957b298a709339fad09.png] 

 2) D is the brother of A and E is the son of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0e7fa1960255237bcff30304e29fd63450fa6ede0e4ef7f0d3dd021c567a2e7.png] 

Hence, E is the **“Paternal Uncle”** of B.
